name: Back-anchored ring-ended 3R (top of the shoulder left bare)
verdict: dead, not worth a GPU sweep. Best honest gap 116.31 (k18) vs 68.93 for the champion 3R. k18: spec J1 site as an O20 hub, J3 hub at d3 50 / th3 30, a12 = a23 = 90, q 0.92. The lowest number in the sweep (82.26, k12, q 0.97) parks hub 2 and the links at the 400 mm never-clears cap, which the kit audit flags; it is not a design. The variant aimed at both limiters (J1 on its square, still posterosuperior seat + O20 hubs + a12 66-75) brings in-band 14 up to the champion's level (0.43, k19), but J2 then swings over the top to the front overhead and reach / follow fall to 0.44 / 0.58. Rings lose to O20 hubs at both ends (k12 82.26 vs k4 86.84).
note: Rebuilt on the shared kit (tools/concept_kit.py): K3 march, K2 dense continuity, K6 collisions, audit. Bench(60,160) fast grid cache, 29 configurations. Rings are flat housed 4.76-section annuli (9 x 8 mm) fitted along their axes; links are 14 x 5.5 Ti straps rooted on 4.5 mm lugs outside the ring races; a 14 x 6 bracket to BOTTOM's bar when J3 is off it. Spec corrections: the arm ring at s 100-160 has its axis 21-31 deg from the humerus axis and stands ~63 deg to the arm skin, so J3 is parametrised by d3 instead; branch -1 puts J2 inside the trunk. Obliquity and skin-motion maps for J1 seats are in the doc.
limiter: link 1, measured. It is a 90 deg rigid arc from the back to J2, and J2 runs between S lat +50 and -23, so link 1 sweeps the whole posterior shoulder: 5 % of its samples in band, median 31.7 mm off the skin; at rest it arches 90 mm above GH, across the top the design meant to leave bare. Overhead (elev 90-150, plane -15..60) link 1 is >= 31.8 mm inside the body and hub 2 up to 23 mm, so 0 of 17 bench poses at elev >= 140 are taken clean. Behind the back, link 2 is squeezed (12 mm inside at plane -75 / elev 30 / axial 165). J1 seat: the ray from GH meets the infraspinous skin at ~52 deg, so a flat 58 mm ring stands at 173 mm over skin at ~117 mm.
audit_note: Audit 2026-10-15T20:36:47Z: death stands. k18 reproduced exactly on Bench(60,160) (gap 116.31, honest). Conventions: the kit reproduces the baseline row exactly (KIT.md). 14 random configurations over a wider box (lat1 -25..50, lon1 -170..-55, a12/a23 60-110, d3 35-92, th3 -40..100, q .90-.97, margin 5/10): best 113.69 (not audit-honest), best honest 128.15. Control with the baseline's 8x3 straps instead of 14x5.5: honest 89.02 (q .92), 78.02 only with parts at the 400 mm cap (q .97) - still > 78.93. Reason: a back-anchored J1 forces link 1 over the whole posterior shoulder and into the body overhead; not a bug, convention or missed range.

mechanism.notes: counted at the best config (k18: p1 = p3 = 0, i.e. O20 hubs at all three joints - a plain spherical 3R). bodies: link 1, link 2, J3 bracket to BOTTOM's bar (arm-end). The ring intent (KAA rings at J1, J3 + O20 at J2) has the same counts, catalogue 2 rings + 2 MR117. custom: base, 2 straps (14 x 5.5), J3 bracket, 3 hub shafts, 1 lug (est.); catalogue 3 x MR117 pair (est.).
